capabilities: Force a per-note open mode via an open-mode frontmatter key
Apply a global default mode for notes without the key
Recognize the legacy obsidianUIMode key from Force note view mode
Keep manual mode switches while a note stays open, reapplying on reopen
Accept mode aliases such as read, preview, source and live
disambiguation: Not a note viewer or renderer; it only decides whether a note opens in reading or editing mode.
extras: Documentation is bilingual (Chinese with English translations) and the settings include a Chinese/English interface language toggle; the README states the plugin only reads frontmatter and never modifies note data.
intentEvidence: recognizes the obsidianUIMode key from Force note view mode, so existing notes migrate with zero changes
problem: Obsidian applies one default view mode to all notes, so notes meant for writing and notes meant for reading always open the same way unless switched manually.
